title: Python: read and reason
description: Python lists are mutable. A tuple is immutable. range(3) produces 0, 1, 2. The len function returns the number of items in a list. A function definition begins with def. Reading code is different from running it; this pack never executes code.

lessons.concept: Python lists are mutable. A tuple is immutable. range(3) produces 0, 1, 2. The len function returns the number of items in a list. A function definition begins with def. Reading code is different from running it; this pack never executes code.

questions.explanation: range(3) starts at zero and stops before three.
Lists are mutable; tuples are immutable.

questions.prompt: A tuple can be changed in place.
Replace ___ with the function that counts items.
questions.explanation: len returns the number of items.

questions.prompt: Which keyword starts a function definition?
questions.explanation: A Python function definition starts with def.
